standard.summary: MiniMax H3 训练时交换到 CPU 的 Transformer block 数量。16GB 显存的默认配方是交换全部 48 个。
standard.effect: 被交换的 block 权重常驻 CPU，前向按需搬运到 GPU；数值越大显存越省、PCIe 传输越多。>0 时后端把 swap_granularity 设为 block，并要求激活检查点为 unsloth 模式（full/selective 无法重载已释放的 block 权重，配置校验直接报错）。
standard.whenToUse: 16GB 级显卡训练 H3 保持默认 48；显存更大时逐步调低换吞吐（每保留一个 block 常驻省一次往返搬运）。
standard.avoidWhen: h3_checkpoint_mode 不是 unsloth 时非零值会被配置校验拒绝；显存充足（>40GB）时交换只会白白付出传输开销。

standard_en.summary: How many transformer blocks are swapped to the CPU during MiniMax H3 training. The 16GB recipe swaps all 48 by default.
standard_en.effect: The swapped blocks' weights live on the CPU and move to the GPU on demand during forward; larger values save more VRAM and move more over PCIe. Above 0 the backend sets swap_granularity to block and requires activation checkpointing in unsloth mode (full/selective cannot reload block weights that were already freed, and config validation rejects them outright).
standard_en.whenToUse: Keep the default of 48 for H3 on a 16GB-class card; with more VRAM, lower it step by step to buy throughput (each block left resident saves one round trip).
standard_en.avoidWhen: A non-zero value is rejected by config validation unless h3_checkpoint_mode is unsloth; and with plenty of VRAM (>40GB) swapping only pays transfer cost for nothing.

advanced.principle: H3 Transformer 的 block 前向是顺序的，block 权重可以在使用前异步预取、用完立即释放，显存峰值从「全部 block」降为「常驻 + 少数在途 block」。与激活检查点的 unsloth 模式配合是因为反传需要按同样的调度重载权重。
advanced.intervention: trainer_prepare_mixin.py：model_arch=minimax_h3 时 config.blocks_to_swap = h3_blocks_to_swap、swap_granularity=block；minimax_h3/loader.py 把该值传入模型构建；configs_h3.py 校验与 checkpoint 模式的互斥关系。
advanced.expectedImpact: 48 全交换时 16GB 卡可跑；吞吐受 PCIe 带宽影响，async 策略下传输大部分被计算掩盖。
advanced.tradeoffs: 交换数量与吞吐近似单调互换；与 h3_block_swap_strategy 联合决定实际重叠效率。

advanced_en.principle: H3 Transformer's block forward is sequential, so block weights can be prefetched asynchronously before use and released right after, dropping peak VRAM from "all blocks" to "resident + a few in-flight blocks". It pairs with unsloth-mode activation checkpointing because backward must reload weights on the same schedule.
advanced_en.intervention: trainer_prepare_mixin.py: when model_arch=minimax_h3, config.blocks_to_swap = h3_blocks_to_swap and swap_granularity=block; minimax_h3/loader.py passes the value into model construction; configs_h3.py validates the mutual exclusion with checkpoint mode.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Full swap of 48 runs on a 16GB card; throughput depends on PCIe bandwidth, with most transfers hidden by compute under the async strategy.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Swap count and throughput trade off near-monotonically; the actual overlap efficiency is decided jointly with h3_block_swap_strategy.
